<dialog id="dialog"><div id="dialog-content"></div></dialog><script>/* A gentle visual rhythm. The release prompts are invitations, not breath rules. */

function showCue(){const target=root?.querySelector('[data-meditation-cue]');if(!target)return;const line=document.createElement('p');line.dataset.meditationCue='';line.textContent=cues[index][lang==='zh'?1:0];target.replaceWith(line);}

/* Original, locally synthesized sound studies. No recordings or remote audio. */
(function(root,factory){const api=factory();if(typeof module==='object'&&module.exports)module.exports=api;else root.CijianAmbience=api;})(globalThis,()=>{
'use strict';
const presets=[['breath','Breathing','呼吸律动','A soft rise and fall','轻轻起伏，一呼一吸'],['wood','Wooden fish','木鱼','A quiet wooden note','一声木响，留一段空白'],['bowl','Singing bowl','颂钵','A warm, lingering ring','清响渐远，慢慢归于安静']];
function generate(kind,rate=22050){
 if(!presets.some(p=>p[0]===kind))kind='breath';
 const duration=kind==='bowl'?20:10,data=new Float32Array(Math.round(rate*duration));
 let seed=7307,low=0,slower=0;
 const noise=()=>{seed=(seed*16807)%2147483647;return seed/2147483647*2-1;};
 const lowAlpha=1-Math.exp(-2*Math.PI*1150/rate),slowAlpha=1-Math.exp(-2*Math.PI*120/rate);
 for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){
  const t=i/rate;let value=0;
  if(kind==='breath'){
   low+=lowAlpha*(noise()-low);slower+=slowAlpha*(low-slower);
   const inhale=t<4,phase=inhale?t/4:(t-4)/6;
   const envelope=Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*phase),1.6)*(inhale?.83:1);
   value=(low-slower)*envelope;
  }else if(kind==='wood'){
   const age=t%2.5,attack=1-Math.exp(-age*1100);
   value=attack*(Math.sin(2*Math.PI*680*age)*Math.exp(-age*29)+.46*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*1047*age)*Math.exp(-age*43)+.24*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*1830*age)*Math.exp(-age*70));
  }else{
   const attack=1-Math.exp(-t*28),release=Math.min(1,(duration-t)/2);
   for(const [freq,amplitude,decay] of [[220,1,4.7],[443.6,.36,3.8],[617.1,.2,3],[1004,.08,2.2]])value+=amplitude*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*freq*t)*Math.exp(-t/decay)*(1+.1*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*1.7*t));
   value*=attack*Math.max(0,release);
  }
  data[i]=value;
 }

 for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++)data[i]=data[i]/(peak||1)*level;
 data[0]=0;data[data.length-1]=0;
 return {data,duration,rate};
}
return {presets,generate};
});

// A quiet ten-minute marker. Audio and seated/breathing controls remain independent.
(() => {
  const duration = 10 * 60 * 1000;
  let startedAt = null, timer = null;
  function paint() {
    const holder = document.getElementById('garden-incense');
    if (!holder || startedAt === null) return;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, 1 - (Date.now() - startedAt) / duration);
    const top = 150 - 104 * remaining;
    holder.querySelector('[data-incense-stick]').setAttribute('y1', top);
    holder.querySelector('[data-incense-ember]').setAttribute('cy', top);
    holder.querySelector('[data-incense-smoke]').setAttribute('transform', `translate(0 ${top - 46})`);
    holder.classList.toggle('burned', remaining === 0);
    holder.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(Math.round((1 - remaining) * 100)));
    if (remaining === 0) stop();
  }
  function stop() { if (timer !== null) clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
  function resume() {
    paint();
    if (startedAt !== null && Date.now() - startedAt < duration && !document.hidden && timer === null) timer = setInterval(paint, 1000);
  }
  window.InvelleIncense = {
    start() { if (startedAt === null) startedAt = Date.now(); resume(); },
    stop,
    language(lang) {
      document.getElementById('garden-incense')?.setAttribute('aria-label', lang === 'en' ? 'Ten-minute incense' : '十分钟静坐香');
    },
  };
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => document.hidden ? stop() : resume());
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', stop);
})();

一处临水的庭院

廊下的蒲团、石阶、松树和水面构成三维空间，远山是一幅轻量景层。点蒲团或“坐一会儿”可以坐下，轻拖画面可以看看四周。

这是空间体验小样。多套场景、背景音乐和语音聊天将在后续版本接入。
